summary: Verified 4 cosmetic linting fixes on Emergent scaffold files (App.js, use-toast.js, server.py). Backend: 3/3 pytest tests pass — GET /api/ returns {'message':'Hello World'}, POST /api/status creates record, GET /api/status returns list without _id leak. Frontend: React app loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, Home renders Emergent logo link with data-testid, no console/page errors. Type hints added to server.py compile fine (server RUNNING under supervisor). useCallback + useEffect dep in App.js compiles and renders. use-toast.js reducer refactor into addToast/updateToast/dismissToast/removeToast helpers is behaviorally equivalent (switch cases delegate to helpers). Note: the actual user deliverable is a Google Apps Script Web App at /app/apps-script/ which is not testable from Emergent; these scaffold files are unused Emergent defaults.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); should migrate to lifespan handlers (non-blocking, cosmetic).
StatusCheck.timestamp is stored as ISO string but response_model coerces back — extra ser/de round-trip could use Pydantic's json_encoders or a proper Mongo BSON datetime instead.
seed_data_creation: 1 TEST_scaffold_client status_check row inserted into MongoDB status_checks collection during pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scaffold files verified. Real user project lives at /app/apps-script/ (Google Apps Script Client Escalation Matrix) — cannot be tested from Emergent due to domain-restricted SSO. /app/backend/tests/test_scaffold.py provides regression coverage for the FastAPI scaffold endpoints.
